issues.title: Title template doubles '| Dental Krafts' suffix
issues.evidence: <title>Dental Treatments in Gurgaon | Implants, RCT, Kids | Dental Krafts | Dental Krafts</title> served on /treatments, /dental-implants, /our-dentists, /contact-us, clinic pages
issues.fix: Drop the trailing '| Dental Krafts' from page-level title strings, or set title:{absolute:...} where the source title already includes the suffix (e.g. t.metaTitle in app/[slug]/page.tsx).

issues.title: Only 2 patient guides; pillar clusters empty
issues.evidence: sitemap lists only /guides/child-first-dental-visit and /guides/dental-implant-vs-bridge; GUIDE_CATEGORIES has 6 categories with 0-1 articles each; checklist requires 5 supporting articles per pillar
issues.fix: Write 5 supporting articles per pillar; keep empty /guides/category/* pages out of sitemap/nav until filled.

issues.title: Banned/risky terms in blog corpus
issues.evidence: L245-272 'painless' ~15x (slug best-painless-dentist-gurgaon); L962-970 'fees/charges'; L659 'dental-implants-types-procedure-benefits-cost-risks'; L1909 'tooth-filling-treatment-type-cost' (slugs contain 'cost'); L264 'game-changer'; L1118 'an Root Canal Treatment specialist' (grammar); reviews.ts:16 quote contains 'charges'
issues.fix: Rewrite or retire offending posts; rename cost-containing slugs and add permanent 301s in next.config.ts; fix grammar; remove 'charges' wording.

issues.title: Missing Editorial Policy and Medical Disclaimer trust pages
issues.evidence: No /editorial-policy or /medical-disclaimer route; footer links only About/Contact/Privacy/Terms
issues.fix: Create both pages with clinic-approved copy and link them in the footer.

issues.title: Hydration mismatch from motion engine
issues.evidence:
dev server log on /root-canal-treatment:

— dk-motion adds .in before hydration completes
issues.fix: Start IntersectionObservers inside requestIdleCallback post-mount (verify timing), or apply reveal state via a data-* attribute React does not own.

issues.title: Home page emits no hreflang
issues.evidence: curl / shows zero hreflang links; ja/ko pages define languages but home does not
issues.fix: Add alternates.languages { 'en-IN':'/', ja:'/japanese', ko:'/korean', 'x-default':'/' } to home metadata.

issues.title: Meta descriptions over 155 chars
issues.evidence: home ~168 chars, /treatments ~162, clinic pages ~163
issues.fix: Trim to <=155 chars keeping location + doctor + proof.

issues.title: Blog posts lack visible dates/reviewed-by; Article schema lacks datePublished
issues.evidence: blog page shows 'By Dr Parmod Gulia · 4 min read' only; no published/updated date; schema has dateModified but no datePublished
issues.fix: Add published/updated fields to posts, render 'Written by / Medically reviewed by / date' near top, emit datePublished in articleNode.

issues.title: guides/[slug] and guides/category/[category] lack ensureStatic
issues.evidence: dev log: 'params accessed outside Suspense may prevent navigation from being instant' error; build output lists routes as PPR (◐)
issues.fix: Add export const ensureStatic = 'navigation' to both route files (same fix applied to [slug] and blog/[slug]).

issues.title: /our-dentists emits no Physician schema
issues.evidence: Served HTML contains only Organization + WebSite ld+json
issues.fix: Emit physicianNode('ruchi') and physicianNode('parmod') via JsonLd.

issues.title: /gallery emits no ImageObject schema
issues.evidence: Served HTML contains only Organization + WebSite
issues.fix: Emit imageObject() for each consented case.

issues.title: /contact-us emits no ContactPoint/LocalBusiness schema
issues.evidence: Served HTML contains only Organization + WebSite
issues.fix: Emit clinicNode() pair or a ContactPage with ContactPoint entries.

issues.title: Sitemap lastModified = build timestamp
issues.evidence: lastmod>2026-10-29T07:20:31 on static/treatment/blog URLs; guides use real dates
issues.fix: Use real per-content modified dates (add a modified field or per-route constants).

issues.title: best-dental-clinic-* pages near-orphan
issues.evidence: 0 inbound links on / and /treatments; only 1 on /dental-implants
issues.fix: Link them from the footer or clinic pages.

issues.title: robots.txt missing Claude-User and Perplexity-User
issues.evidence: AI_BOTS list lacks both; checklist requires them
issues.fix: Append 'Claude-User' and 'Perplexity-User' to AI_BOTS.

issues.title: OG image not 1200x630
issues.evidence: doctors-duo.webp is 1536x1024
issues.fix: Export a dedicated 1200x630 og-image variant.

issues.title: AI writing tells in blog corpus
issues.evidence: 'game-changer' L264, 'daunting task' L250, filler closers; 16 hits on banned-phrase scan
issues.fix: Edit or retire the weakest posts; keep guides-style voice.

issues.title: No manifest.webmanifest
issues.evidence: No manifest route in build output
issues.fix: Add app/manifest.ts with name, icons, theme_color.

issues.title: /guides index title thin
issues.evidence: served title 'Patient guides | Dental Krafts' (30 chars; spec wants 50-60)
issues.fix: Lengthen to e.g. 'Dental Patient Guides | Written by Specialists | Dental Krafts'.

issues.title: No Wikidata/Wikipedia sameAs links
issues.evidence: sameAs only lists social profiles
issues.fix: Add Wikidata/Wikipedia sameAs for doctors/clinic where profiles exist.

issues.title: vercel.app preview deploy not confirmed noindex
issues.evidence: cannot verify locally; checklist requires preview URLs noindexed
issues.fix: Set X-Robots-Tag: noindex on the Vercel preview project or via vercel.json headers.
